name: Rave Rabier
source:
Rave isn't the brightest blub in the box, but he's kind and helpful. It took him a while to learn that he was a mage, and he isn't comfortable using magic when he needs it yet. 

He's the main character—the one you’ll be playing as this whole time.

Magic: Wind Elemental
Occupation: Student
Species: Human
